the following contributions: 1) we propose a novel neural multi-atlas segmentation framework for better solving the challenges of atlas selection and label propagation; 2) our framework is capable of automatically learning optimal features for label propagation, which can be applied to other segmentation tasks with minimal modification; 3) our method is the first to apply neural multi-atlas framework to cardiac MR images, which achieved the state-of-the-art performance on SATA-13 and CAP datasets.

deep learning can be utilized in multi-atlas segmentation for both atlas selection and label estimation, and the deep features learned in a label estimation subnet can be utilized to improve atlas selection.
